description.7.0: Sample geogrid responses. The nodes of an element will be ordered counterclockwise with respect to the outside of the zone faces upon which the geogrid was created.
description.9.0: ELEMENT SPEC REQUIRED: after the quantity keyword, the target must be identified with 'component-id <i>' or 'position <v>' — otherwise the engine rejects with 'Must specify an element, by component-id or position.' Verified live against FLAC3D 9.7 (beam and shell families; both forms created histories).

notes: '[geogridhistoryblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (component-id, depth-factor, node, position, surface-x, name).

description.7.0: the element is selected by its individual component ID number
description.9.0: the element with component ID ind is selected.

description.7.0: the depth factor used to determine element stresses. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the depth factor at which elastic element stresses are computed (see the structure geogrid recover stress command). If this keyword is not specified, then the depth factor is set to +1. Only available if noted.

keywords.name: integration-point
keywords.description: the integration point at which stresses are sampled. Integration-point locations follow the plastic-integration layout configured with 'structure <type> cmodel plastic-integration'; the layout figure is on the official Structural Elements formulation pages (the original hyperlink target, lost in extraction). If this keyword is not specified, then the integration point index is set to 1 . Only available if noted.

description.7.0: the node location to use when retrieving values from the element. Must be from 1 to 3. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the node location to use when retrieving values from the element. Must be from 1 to 3 . If this keyword is not specified, then the node location is set to 1 . Only available if noted.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: the element with a centroid closest to v is selected

description.7.0: the local \(x\)-direction used to determine the local surface coordinate system. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the surface-x vector whose projection onto the element plane defines the x-direction of the surface coordinate system (see the structure geogrid recover surface command). If this keyword is specified, then the surface coordinate system of the three nodes used by the element will be modified.
